payload.entry:
CROSS-EPIC COORDINATION from bob-cli-ls.land:
(a) bob bank config update category.remove (refuse_in_use / UsageIndex in src/native/bank/config_update) counts rows and rules but not subscription records whose category field holds the key. Removing a key used only by a subscription record succeeds and leaves bank_subscription_category_unknown behind. The bob-cli-ls landing tale will make category.remove also refuse when subscription records use the key. lt.land need not do this.
(b) docs/bank.md: lt's membership line ('the hub's bank: setup') and ls's runner.rs about-line ('the subscription records rows link to') each dropped the other's wording. The ls landing tale merges both and adds bob bank subscriptions to the docs/bank.md usage block.
(c) The ls landing tale trims bob-plugins docs/bob-ledger-tools.md to 6000 words or fewer. Before trimming in lt.land, pull and re-measure; trim only if the page is still over the cap.

LAND TRIAGE (bob-cli-lt.land). Integration edits (bob-cli, committed with this landing turn): (1) bob bank subscriptions (f252f185, landed in parallel) now emits one located bank_config_invalid finding per config diagnostic (line + key_path, check's shape) instead of one unlocated first message; new CLI test subscriptions_reports_every_located_config_finding. (2) category.remove and its undo_blocked guard now also count subscription records whose category names the key (SubscriptionRegistry, all statuses), so the writer never strands a subscription's category; plan_update takes SubscriptionRefs; docs/bank.md op table updated; unit test subscription_records_block_category_remove_and_its_undo. just check passed (exit 0). Follow-ups: lt.2 #1 (cargo fmt gcal_auth.rs) declined: cargo fmt --check is clean on current master. lt.3 #2 (configuration.md 6009 words) declined: docs-check no longer reports that page. lt.3 #3 and lt.7 #2 timing flakes corroborated as +1 on existing bob-cli-km (event-link-times), bob-cli-ki (keep-moving surface, 306.6 ms), and bob-cli-ju (off-clock chips); no new task. lt.3 #1, lt.5 #1, lt.6 #1, lt.7 #1, lt.8 #1 (bob-ledger-tools reference at 6302/6000 words) are epic work, not a task: the landing tale trims the page under the cap without raising budgets (related standing headroom task bob-cli-il). Plan item 4 deferred work filed: bob-cli-m4 (bank category-key rename/merge and account alias rename migrations, large, related bob-cli-lz) and bob-cli-m5 (+ Rule from the Category card, medium, related bob-cli-m3). The subscription-candidate rule dismissal is already owned by bob-cli-m3; no new task. bob-cli-lq verified and closed. Remaining epic work, planned as a landing tale: the Setup e2e scenarios, real-Obsidian acceptance with screenshots, the leftover .bob-bank-hub-note CSS hide that defeats the scoped Setup-surface hide, the docs trim, gates/sync, and closeout.
